_note: 화풍 = 시안 A 원본 크레파스 (11-06 사용자: 기존 크레파스 느낌으로). 원본 사이트 그림을 참고 그림(ref)으로 같이 보낸다. name = public/bg 파일 이름 = lib/backgrounds.ts id. 순서는 앱 목록 순서.
common: A background illustration for a grown-up's picture diary app. The user will draw themselves on top of it with a crayon brush, so: NO people, NO animals, NO faces, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO signs with writing, NO signature, NO frame or border. Keep colors light and soft (lower saturation) and leave an open, simple area in the lower middle where a person could be drawn. Keep all important elements inside the central 4:3 area; the far left and right edges will be cropped. Fill the whole canvas edge to edge.

style.chosen: Style: match the attached reference exactly — a child's wax crayon drawing on white paper, visible crayon strokes and paper grain, simple rounded shapes, warm cheerful colors, slightly wobbly lines. Use the reference only for drawing style; do not copy its boy, food or table.
